title: Page 8
content_zh:
“少了一魂一魄当然会伤寿数，不过他既是你的魂主，师公又怎会让他出什么问题？”他怎可能让心爱的徒孙早早就随斐然去了？他自然有办法补上寿数这个大洞。

“那……”

清远拈着洁白的长须，“这也没什么，只要灌一灌就好了。”

“灌什么？”斐然愈听愈觉得不对。

“灌顶。”

“……”他们要不要说得那么云淡风轻，就像在讨论今年过年要不要灌个香肠一样？

“小伙子你放心，只是会疼那么一下下而已。”清远虽是说着安慰的话语，可听起来却一点说服力也没有。

慢着，他什么都还没有答应好吗？

骤感不妙的斐然，在清远甩着两手带着满面坏坏的笑意走向他时，他两脚不住地腾腾往后退。

“善善？”他边退边看向上一任也曾经被灌过的前辈。

岂料身为先烈的尚善却缩着两肩，不忍卒睹地别过脸去。

“乖，很快……就会过去的。”那是她连想都不愿回想起来的噩梦啊。

清远一把按住想要脚底抹油的斐然，不容抗拒地将掌心覆上了他的头顶，让前阵子才刚因补魂魄而痛过一回的他，又再次品尝到极痛的滋味。

噼哩啪啦的电光在殿内大作，交织闪烁的光芒，无比璀璨耀眼，也格外伤害斐然那一颗愈来愈脆弱的心。

嗅着一殿略带焦香的气味，尚善在清远真人去找其他师祖爷爷打牌后，蹲在浑身都还在冒烟的斐然的身旁，再次以指戳戳他。

“别戳了……”他总算明白，这年头要想当个好魂主是有多么的不易。

她伸出两指在他的面前摇晃，“我有两个消息，一个好的一个坏的，你想先听哪个？”

“……好的。”眼下他身残志不坚，极需要那一点点的安慰。

“好消息是，你没性命之忧了，往后会一路活到你该有的寿数，咱俩的性命都获得了保障。”

“那坏消息是？”该不会时不时就要补充法力再灌他一下吧？

她以无比怜悯的目光看着他，“唔，在受了我师公给你的法力后，你就是我师公半个未入门的弟子。”

“这意思是……”他微微抬起头，内心浮上了一股不妙的预感，“往后我也要跟着你一块儿吃素？”

“很不幸的是，你答对了。”很高兴终于有人能够加入她的吃素地狱里。

“……”他真的可以少活几年的，真的。

尚善在身上拍了一张大力金刚符，一把拖起赖在地上不肯起来的他，半拖半扛地带着他往内殿的方向走去，但走到一半，她这才想起她好像还忘了提醒他一件事。

“这阵子你若是远远见着我师父的话，你最好是赶快绕道走。”

“为何？”斐然自认近来已经受遍了各式苦难，应当是没什么消息能够再打击到他了。

她语带保留地道：“道家代代都是一脉单传，因此我师父自然不会承认你是我师公的半个弟子，所以……”

斐然木着一张脸，一鼓作气推论完成，“他该不会为了什么道家规矩，记恨上我这个外人，却因不能杀我，所以想蹂躏我千百遍吧？”

“嗯，我怕他忍不住手痒。”实际上，清罡是她见过最小心眼的人了，高洁的他眼中就连颗沙都容不下，何况是斐然这么大的一个目标？

“……”现在下山还来得及吗？

再次被扛去同样的客房养伤，斐然还没躺满两天，就又再次生龙活虎，一个劲地钻进了厨房去帮尚善的忙，只因再过几日就要过年了。

齐心合力的他俩，在过年前，跑了山下的镇子好几趟买齐应节用品，尚善按着清罡真人的吩咐，全心泡在厨房里准备祭天要用的祭品，而斐然则是先修好数张被掀坏的牌桌，再花了一整日的时间，炒出了几大锅的花生米与瓜子，以供那票老道士打牌时有零嘴可吃，他甚至还包办了极悟堂和旁边的几座大殿的打扫工程。

除夕那一天，身为掌门的清罡真人领着尚善登上天坛祭过天后，灯影绰绰的极悟堂内，又再次聚满了一票白胡子的老道士大打麻将，而总算把所有事情都忙完的两位小辈，牵着彼此的手悄悄退出殿外，踩着堆积一地的厚雪回到了尚善的小院里。

窗外雪落无声，房内的火炉偶尔爆出噼啪的轻响声，尚善将置在炉边烤好的橘子取下，优闲地吃着经烤过后风味更加甜美的橘子，晚饭没吃饱的斐然则拿出他窝藏起来的年糕，眼巴巴地等着放在烤架上的年糕冒出香气。

看着眼前这名穿着一身素袍不再光彩夺目，边嘶吃着烫热的年糕边伸舌头喊烫的然公子，尚善不禁心下有些感慨。

“你真要留在这？”

“嗯。”他哪能丢下她一人？

她叹了口气，“你是个武者，又无心修道，你不必在这陪着我的。”这几日清罡真人三番两次暗示他可以滚下山、回去跟他的家人过年了，偏偏他不是当没听见就是装不明白。

斐然不语地瞥她一眼，吹凉被烫红的手指头后坐至她的身旁，低首一口吃掉她正欲放进口中的橘子，并顺势将她带进怀里，吻上那张他想念已久的芳唇。

芳香甜蜜的味道交织在他俩的唇舌之间，即使口中的橘子早已经没了，斐然霸道的舌依旧紧缠着她不放，即使双耳听见了她细小的轻吟声，按在他胸膛上的一双素手，也因喘不过气来而开始推搡着，可他紧箍着她纤腰的手臂就是不愿意松开。

他的确没想过要当什么道士，在这座道观之外，也有着一片由他多年打造出来、纯属于他自己的天空。但如果她得一辈子都待在这座山头上的话，那么，他也只能选择抛下一切。

她或许不明白，在他已经找到了人生目标之后，放弃那些曾让人称羡的过往种种，对他来说，从来就不是个难题。

他在她的唇上低喃，“既然众生皆苦，而你又最苦，那么我只好陪着你一块儿苦了。”

“不后悔？”总是动不动就被他这般偷袭，尚善从一开始还会红着脸对他拳打脚踢，已演变成现在只瞪他个两眼就随便他去了。

“我已经后悔够了。”他的指尖爱怜地抚过她的脸庞，“日后，不会再后悔了。”

灼热的气息再次扑面而来，在她的默许下，他先是在她的唇上浅浅地轻吻，见她没有反对，他又再深入了点，以舌尖轻挑着她的舌尖，直到她的双臂主动绕上他的肩头时，他才彻底放下心，在她的口中攻城掠地。

“怎么办，我又有点冲动……”他埋首在她的颈间印下几记湿热的吻，压抑不住满心的悸动，双唇亦顺势地一路往下滑。

“等等……”尚善赶在他又激动得一发不可收拾之前，一掌抵在他的下巴上推开他，“有件事我老早就想问你了。”

“何事？”

“当年你不是被迫拿不举当代价吗？那怎么它还站得起来？”这是至今她一直都不明白、也怎么想都想不通的一点。

“呃，当年在许愿的时候……”斐然以指刮着面颊，“我动了点手脚。”他又不呆，哪能让杜衍仲就那么简单得逞？

她的双眼紧紧锁住他看似有些心虚的模样。

“什么手脚？”身为魂纸的受害者，她就不信这世上有什么人能够敌得过魂纸的力量。

“我趁他们没注意时，在魂纸上偷偷加了三个字。”

“哪三字？”
content_en:
"Of course losing a soul will shorten your life, but since he is your soul master, how could Master let him have any problems?" How could he let his beloved disciple follow Fei Ran so early?Naturally, he has a way to make up for the big hole in his lifespan.

"Then..."

Qingyuan twirled his long white beard and said, "It's nothing, just give it a drink and it'll be fine."

"What are you talking about?" The more Feiran listened, the more he felt something was wrong.

"Initiation."

"..." Do they want to say it so calmly, as if they are discussing whether to stuff sausages for Chinese New Year this year?

"Don't worry, young man, it's just going to hurt a little bit." Although Qingyuan said comforting words, he didn't sound convincing at all.

Wait, he hasn't agreed to anything yet, okay?

Suddenly feeling something bad, when Qingyuan walked toward him with a wicked smile on his face, waving his hands, he kept jumping back with his feet.

"Shan Shan?" He stepped back and looked at his predecessor who had also been raped before.

Unexpectedly, as a martyr, Shang Shan hunched his shoulders and turned away in disgust.

"Be good, it will pass soon..." That was a nightmare that she didn't even want to recall.

Qingyuan held down Feiran who wanted to apply oil on his soles, and irresistibly put his palm on the top of his head, letting him, who had just been in pain from replenishing his soul a while ago, taste the extreme pain again.

The crackling lightning flashed in the hall, interweaving and flickering light, extremely bright and dazzling, and particularly hurting Feiran's increasingly fragile heart.

Smelling the slightly burnt smell of the hall, Shang Shan squatted down next to Fei Ran, who was still smoking all over his body, and poked him again after Qingyuan Zhenren went to play cards with other masters.

"Stop poking..." He finally understood how difficult it was to be a good soul master these days.

She stretched out two fingers and shook them in front of him, "I have two pieces of news, one good and one bad. Which one do you want to hear first?"

"...Okay." Right now, he was physically disabled and weak in spirit, and he desperately needed that little bit of comfort.

"The good news is that you don't have to worry about your life anymore. You will live as long as you deserve. Our lives are both guaranteed."

"Then what's the bad news?" Shouldn't he need to replenish his mana from time to time?

She looked at him with extremely pitiful eyes, "Well, after receiving the magic power given to you by my master, you will become half of my master's disciples."

"This means..." He raised his head slightly, with an unpleasant premonition in his heart, "I will also become a vegetarian with you in the future?"

"Unfortunately, you got it right." Glad someone finally joined her in her vegetarian hell.

"..." He can really lose a few years of his life, really.

Shang Shan took a picture of the powerful Vajra Talisman on his body, dragged him up who was lying on the ground and refused to get up, and half dragged and half carried him towards the inner hall. But halfway there, she remembered that she seemed to have forgotten to remind him of something.

"If you see my master from a distance these days, you'd better take a detour as soon as possible."

"Why?" Feiran thought that he had suffered all kinds of hardships recently, so there should be no news that could hit him again.

She said with reservation: "Taoism has been passed down by a single line for generations, so naturally my master will not admit that you are half a disciple of my master, so..."

Fei Ran made a sullen expression and finished his reasoning in one breath, "Could it be that he has a grudge against me, an outsider, because of some Taoist rules, but because he can't kill me, he wants to ravage me thousands of times?"

"Well, I'm afraid he can't help itching." In fact, Qinggang is the most narrow-minded person she has ever seen. He is so noble that he can't even hold a grain of sand in his eyes, let alone such a big target as Fei Ran?

"..." Is it still too late to go down the mountain now?

After being carried to the same guest room again to recuperate, Feiran didn't lie down for two days before he was full of life again and got into the kitchen to help Shangshan, just because the Chinese New Year would be coming in a few days.

The two of them worked together and went to the town down the mountain several times to buy supplies for the festival before the Chinese New Year. Shangshan followed the instructions of Master Qinggang and concentrated on preparing sacrifices in the kitchen, while Feiran repaired several quilts first.After overturning the broken card table, he spent a whole day frying several large pots of peanuts and melon seeds to provide the old Taoist priest with snacks to eat while playing cards. He even undertook the cleaning project of Jiwu Hall and several nearby halls.

On New Year's Eve, Master Qinggang, as the leader, led Shang Shan to the Temple of Heaven to offer sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven. The dimly lit Jiwu Hall was once again filled with white-bearded old Taoist priests playing mahjong. The two juniors, who had finally finished everything, held each other's hands and quietly exited the hall, stepping on the thick snow piled on the ground to return to Shang Shan's courtyard.

The snow fell silently outside the window, and the stove in the room occasionally made a crackling sound. Shang Shan took down the roasted oranges placed by the stove and ate leisurely the oranges that had a sweeter flavor after roasting. Fei Ran, who was not full from dinner, took out the rice cakes he had hidden and eagerly waited for the aroma of the rice cakes on the grill to come out.

Seeing Mr. Ran in front of him, who was no longer dazzling in his plain robe, eating hot rice cakes while sticking out his tongue to say "hot rice cakes", Shang Shan couldn't help feeling a little emotional.

"Do you really want to stay here?"

"Yeah." How could he leave her alone?

She sighed, "You are a warrior and have no intention of practicing Taoism. You don't have to stay with me here." In the past few days, Master Qinggang hinted repeatedly that he could roll down the mountain and go back to celebrate the New Year with his family, but he either pretended not to hear or pretended not to understand.

He glanced at her without saying a word, then sat down next to her after cooling off his scalded fingers. He lowered his head and ate the orange she was about to put in her mouth. He then took her into his arms and kissed the fragrant lips that he had missed for a long time.

The sweet and fragrant taste intertwined between their lips and tongues. Even though the orange in his mouth had long since disappeared, Fei Ran's overbearing tongue was still tightly wrapped around her. Even though his ears heard her soft moans, the bare hands on his chest started to push because he was out of breath, but his arms tightly holding her slender waist refused to let go.

He really never thought about becoming a Taoist priest. Outside of this Taoist temple, there is also a sky that he has built over many years and is purely his own.But if she had to stay on this mountain all her life, then he could only choose to leave everything behind.

She may not understand that after he has found his life goal, it has never been a problem for him to give up the things he once admired in the past.

He murmured on her lips, "Since all living beings suffer, and you suffer the most, I have no choice but to suffer with you."

"Don't regret it?" He was always attacked by him at every turn. From the beginning, Shang Shan would punch and kick him with a blushing face, but now he just glared at him and let him go as he pleased.

"I regret it enough." His fingertips caressed her face lovingly, "I won't regret it anymore in the future."

The hot breath came to his face again. With her acquiescence, he first kissed her lightly on the lips. Seeing that she had no objection, he went a little deeper and gently teased the tip of her tongue with his tongue. It was not until her arms actively wrapped around his shoulders that he completely relaxed and attacked her mouth.

"What should I do? I'm a little impulsive..." He buried his head and pressed a few wet kisses on her neck. Unable to suppress the throbbing in his heart, his lips slid down.

"Wait..." Shang Shan, before he got too excited again, put a palm on his chin and pushed him away, "There's something I've wanted to ask you for a long time."

"What's the matter?"

"Weren't you forced to pay the price for not lifting? Then how could you still stand up?" This is something she still doesn't understand and can't figure out no matter how hard she thinks about it.

"Well, when I was making a wish..." Fei Ran scratched his cheek with his finger, "I did some tricks." He was not dumb, how could he let Du Yanzhong succeed so easily?

Her eyes were locked on his seemingly guilty look.

"What hands and feet?" As a victim of the soul paper, she didn't believe that anyone in the world could defeat the power of the soul paper.

"When they weren't paying attention, I secretly added three words on the soul paper."

"What three words?"
